title: Nope Scratch That: A Historical Dataset of Revisions to Scratch Files
summary: A research codebase for collecting Scratch file revision history from World of Code and building a SQLite database of commits, authors, and parsed Scratch file content. The only match to the SDV family is a coincidental substring "sdv" inside an unrelated conda cache file path in requirements.txt, not an actual reference to the Synthetic Data Vault.
evidence: requirements.txt: 'more-itertools @ file:///private/var/.../abs_e2687gwsdv/...' — coincidental substring, no SDV usage
